name: codex-director
description: Start and operate a project-scoped Codex Director that titles and pins a coordinator thread, then routes work to bounded worker threads.

interface.shortDescription: Start a pinned Director thread for project coordination.
interface.longDescription: Codex Director starts a stable, pinned project coordinator thread, then routes project work to bounded Codex worker threads with explicit $codex-director:director-* workflow skills, signal-first callbacks, child-thread readback, helper/subagent lanes, heartbeat watchdogs, research, oracle checks, adversarial review, goals, git/worktree policy, and concise evidence reporting.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-director:codex-director to start a Director for this project.
Use $codex-director:codex-director to coordinate this project with Director workers.
Use $codex-director:codex-director to audit this project's Director ledger.
